content: An'yääm a Petↄlà anà Ikööŋ u Yɛlusàlɛm
Antööm anà atↄŋ bàkäl u Yuday bàwem naa baar mpa abà Ayudà sye ban'wal Ndaa a Nzam.
Wԑԑ mpal kàbeenà Petↄlà Yԑlusàlԑm, baar bàŋàkyԑy bàkäl musà mbaaŋ anà nde.
Ba bàtԑn a nde naa: « Ngye an'kàbilà u ndwà a baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n aŋàkyԑy anà an'kàdyà ikal imwԑy anà ba. »
Apan, Petɔlà kàsԑmà mukakyään ndaa yanswà pànsi pànsi asànaa yàlyaaŋ ya. Waa kàtɛn a ba naa:
« Mԑ, mɛ kàkäl uboo a Yↄpԑ muyamà, laa kàkabà mɛ, waa kàmԑn imanmii: undiir mwԑy kan'fà du wàŋàbäm in'siŋ a bwԑlàbwԑl kà an'twԑrà man'nà asànaa yar a ipfԑy.
Mpal kàsyeebà mɛ boo awa ubwaŋàbwaŋ, mɛ kàmԑn ntsür a in'kↄl in'nà, ntsür a ndwaŋ, ntsür ifilaan u mɛɛn anà nԑn a du.
Apan, mɛ kàwem ndaa mwԑy yàmukan'kyäänà naa: "Petↄlà, kyen, dwa, dyà."
Wԑԑ mԑ kàtԑn naa: "Aay, Mwol, akà undiir mwԑy wà ikin itàkal wàŋingyäy ŋatàbilà anki u mun amԑ."
Ndaa yan'fàfà du mbalà yàyweel, yan'fuur naa: "Indiir kàpɔŋà Nzam, twon an'bel bya mbiin."
Ndaa ayi yàkyer abà mbalà tär. Ungö, indiir byanswà byàfurà du.
Kyekà taaŋ nsil alan, abaal atär bàyàkↄlà u ndwà kàkäl bi. Ba ban'tööm abà u Sɛzarɛ.
Apan, Dweelà kan'kyään naa mԑ in'kyen mbwo mwԑy anà ba ukɔɔn nkyɛɛr. Atɔŋ bà basyaam bàyan'swà. Bi banswà kàkàbilà u ndwà a mbuur awun.
Nde kà ikyään naa un'kyeey kàyàmԑnà aben u ndwà ande anà kun'kyään naa: "Tↄm mbuur mwey u Yↄpԑ mukàbel Simↄn awà bàfàbel naa Petↄlà.
Nde ayakyään ndaa yanswà iyàtswà ngye mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà ndwà angye yanswà."
Pa kàsɛmà mɛ mutԑn, Dweelà kàyàtyà udu a ba asànaa kàyàtyà nde udu a bi u nsɛmà.
Apan, mɛ kàyↄbà ndaa kàtԑn Mwol naa: "Ywan kàfadümà kà an'dà. Wԑԑ bԑ, bԑ bàsàladümà u Dweelà In'kyԑɛl."
Abun, Nzam kapԑ kab nsil la asànaa kàpԑ nde bi umpal kàsi bi làkwikillà amu Yԑsu Klistↄ, mԑ, mɛ kàkäl nà mutsuŋ Nzam? »
Ungö bàwem ba ndaa ayi, ba bàkäl a duu, bàsi Nzam làkoo, waa bàtԑn naa: « Abà Nzam kan'pà mbwo sye akà baar mpa abà Ayudà musↄↄmà nkääl aba anà muwal mɔ̈ɔ̈. »
Ikööŋ a Antyↄsha
Yàmԑnà naa aŋàlàkwikilà bàkyer atà upay mper yanswà ntɔn nkwaaŋ bamɛɛy mpal bàdwä Ityen. Ba bàkàkɔlà anà u Fԑnisi, u Shipԑlɛ anà Antyↄsha. Wԑԑ ba Ndaa a Nzam bàyilↄɔŋà Ayudà mpԑl.
Wԑԑ bumwԑy bàkäl baar a Shipԑlɛ anà Sirԑn. Umpal bàtöl ba Antyↄsha, ba bàkyäänà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Mwol Yɛsu akà Angԑlԑki sye.
Kↄↄ a Mwol làkäl anà ba, undiir awun baar mbↄↄn bàsi ba làkwikilà anà bàbuul ba mpem akà Mwol.
Mpal kyàwem Ikööŋ a Yԑlusàlԑm ndaa ayi, ba bàtöm Banabasi u Antyↄsha.
Umpal kàtöl nde anà kàmԑn nde kab a ngway a Nzam, nde kàmԑn un'sak, nde kàlɔ̈ɔ̈m ba banswà mukal uboo a un'tüüb a Mwol u mpem aba yanswà.
Ntɔn nde kàkäl mbuur mwԑy wàŋàbwaŋ, wàŋàyↄl a Dweelà In'kyɛԑl anà làkwikilà. Apan, un'kàbɔ a baar kàyàtüüb anà Mwol.
Ungö apan, Banabasi kàkyen Tarsis mukàleŋ Sↄl.

Umpal kun'mԑn nde, nde kun'twääl u Antyↄsha. Ba bàkyer mbul mwԑy aŋun'kiinà musal mbwo mwԑy anà mulↄŋ iköŋ a baar uboo a Ikööŋ. Ya yàkäl mbalà atàtwԑb u Antyↄsha bàbel ba alↄŋki naa aklistↄ.
Kà ilä abin, aŋangↄↄm bàfü Yԑlusàlԑm bàyàtyà Antyↄsha.
Wԑԑ umwԑy uboo aba, ikↄb ande Agabüs, kàkyer ambarà, waa kàkyään u mbwo a Dweelà naa ngyal mbɔɔn ikyer ayàbilà u mԑԑn manswà. Ya sye yàkäl abun u paŋà a Kɔlↄde.
Abun, alↄŋki bàtsül mbar naa mbuur mbuur upԑ kab kan'kwo nde mupà ntɔn mutööm atↄŋ abà u Yuday.
Ba bàkyer abun sye, waa bàtöm an'kab aman akà andweer u mbwo a Banabasi anà Sↄl.
